request.spec:
The audit viewer, filtered by a name, now also lists the matching lines of the sheet's descendants
(each sheet's lines newest first, sheets by id, after this sheet's own lines and before the lines
from the sheet a person came from).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The audit viewer, filtered by a name, now also lists the matching lines of the sheet's descendants
(each sheet's lines newest first, sheets by id, after this sheet's own lines and before the lines
from the sheet a person came from).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
When you filter the audit viewer by a name, it now also shows that person's lines from the sheet's descendants. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

Lines now come in this order:
1. This sheet's own lines, newest first.
2. Each descendant sheet's lines (children, their children and so on), sheets in id order, each sheet's lines newest first.
3. The lines from the sheet the person came from, as before.

With a blank filter, the viewer still shows only this sheet's own lines. Descendants count only when a name is given.

The change is in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/auditview/RespondWithAuditLines.java`, which finds the descendants using the existing `SheetRepository.childrenOf` query. It skips the sheet itself and any sheet it has already seen, so a loop of parent settings can't list lines twice or never finish. I also updated the comment in `audit.GET.yml` to describe the new order. No front-end, schema or audit-record changes were needed.
